sections.title: I understand / I don't understand
sections.content: *Értem* means "I understand" on its own — no separate word for "I" needed, just like *vagyok*. Put *nem* in front, exactly as you learned in Unit 1, to say *nem értem*, "I don't understand".

*Nem értem* is one of the most useful sentences you'll ever learn in a new language — it turns a conversation you've lost track of into one you can steer back on course, instead of just nodding along.
